normalizationNotes: DESIGN.md frontmatter owns primitives. Native C++ source is implementation authority.
Tonal ramps are synthesized OKLCH display aids, not implemented palette variants.
HTML/SVG snippets are static panel specimens of native geometry, not application code. Fonts depend on the viewer; the app bundles its fonts.
Diagnostic em dashes are specimen placeholders, never health data. Zero-input visuals demonstrate geometry only.
Current tokens and narrative describe the LG-referenced native adaptation. Legacy component specimens are retained and explicitly archived, not silently migrated.
No LG runtime font axes, automatic night register, exact palette extraction or field reveal are implied.

narrative.overview:
Afterglow PS5 adapts the user-selected current LG webOS Afterglow: a heavy Archivo title, full-height cropped artwork, warm paper on ink and flat track-colour fields. The music owns the screen; controls stay readable from the sofa and MilkDrop retains its own visual language.

This records the implemented native adaptation, not exact LG CSS parity. The authority is the LG DESIGN.md and the native source; the retained upstream gallery is outside this surface. The previous Inter/Montserrat chrome and six-section information panel are superseded.
keyCharacteristics: Archivo poster typography and a full-height left artwork slab.
Flat square fields, warm paper focus inversion and no fixed chrome accent.
Four display modes and Browse, Now playing, Queue, Settings navigation.
A single caption field over the visualizer, optionally carrying a timed lyric.

rules.name: The No House Accent Rule
rules.body: Chrome emphasis uses Paper; track fields take their colour from artwork.

dos: Do retain Archivo, warm paper, ink and square poster fields.
Do derive track fields from artwork and check readable text contrast.
Do preserve native controller focus and honest missing-data states.
Do distinguish illustrative captures from hardware performance evidence.
donts: Don't reinstate mint focus, six top-level sections or the old small-artwork composition.
Don't claim exact LG palette, night-register, animation or layout parity.
Don't add blur, shadows or decorative chrome over MilkDrop.
